title: pfBlockerNG supported-versions matrix
description: Each entry describes one supported pfSense version and its build environment (FreeBSD ABI + PHP runtime). Workflows read this at runtime to drive .pkg builds and CI.

pfsense_version.description: pfSense version label, e.g. '2.8.x' or '25.03'. For CE minor families use 'X.Y.x'; for Plus use the Plus release label.

channel.description: CE = Community Edition; Plus = pfSense Plus (build-only, ci must be false).

freebsd_version.description: Full FreeBSD version string used as the build environment, e.g. '15.0-RELEASE'. Matches build-pkg.yml's freebsd_version input.

freebsd_major.description: FreeBSD major version digit only, e.g. '15'. Used to construct the ABI tag FreeBSD:<major>:amd64 for build-pkg-linux.yml and for artifact dedup (one .pkg per distinct major).

php_version.description: PHP version string, e.g. '8.3'. Passed to both builders to pin USES=php so dep names match the target pfSense.

py_flavor.description: Python flavor string, e.g. 'py311'. Passed to build-pkg-linux.yml (portable builder). build-pkg.yml derives it from the VM's installed Python.

status.description: beta = pre-release; GA = generally available. Set to beta when first added; update to GA on release.

ci.description: true = include in the CI smoke matrix (CE only). false = build-only (always false for Plus; use for beta CE if no image is available yet).
